Interface NavigationListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
DetourPlanner
public interface NavigationListener
Hears a Navigator's progress along its path, as leJOS's listener of the same name does. The calls come from the navigator's own thread, so keep them short; the pose is the navigator's, read it there and then.

      void atWaypoint(Waypoint waypoint, Pose pose, int sequence)

    • pathComplete

      void pathComplete(Waypoint waypoint, Pose pose, int sequence)
      waypoint was the path's last: it is now empty. Called after atWaypoint(Waypoint, Pose, int) for the same waypoint.

    • pathInterrupted

      void pathInterrupted(Waypoint waypoint, Pose pose, int sequence)
      Driving to waypoint ended without reaching it: Navigator.stop() was called, or a move failed or timed out, or the robot stayed outside the waypoint's tolerance. The waypoint stays first in the path.
